name: crane
description: Google's OCI image manipulation tool for container registries without Docker daemon

crane.description: OCI image registry manipulation tool for copying, inspecting, and modifying container images
crane.usage:
crane copy alpine:latest myregistry.com/alpine:latest
crane ls gcr.io/distroless/base
crane config alpine:latest | jq '.'
crane append --new_layer layer.tar --new_tag myapp:v1 base:latest
crane manifest alpine:latest

gcrane.description: Google Container Registry (GCR) specific version of crane with enhanced authentication
gcrane.usage: gcrane copy gcr.io/project/image:tag gcr.io/project/image:new\ngcrane ls gcr.io/project\ngcrane auth login

krane.description: Kubernetes-focused crane variant for working with container images in K8s contexts
krane.usage: krane copy image:latest localhost:5000/image:latest\nkrane validate image:tag
